title: Kubernetes v1.37：Memory QoS 升级至 Beta 并默认启用
english: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes Memory QoS to Beta and enables it by default. On Linux nodes using cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to provide the kernel with better guidance for container memory handling. Memory QoS was introduced as an Alpha feature in v1.22 and gained tiered memory reservation support in v1.36. For cluster operators, the Beta transition means MemoryQoS should be evaluated as part of capacity planning, workload testing, and node-level observability. Teams should understand its behavior before relying on it for memory-sensitive production workloads.
chinese: Kubernetes v1.37 将 Memory QoS 提升为 Beta，并默认启用。该能力面向使用 cgroup v2 的 Linux 节点，通过内存控制器向内核提供更明确的容器内存处理指引。Memory QoS 最早在 v1.22 以 Alpha 形式引入，并在 v1.36 扩展了分层内存预留能力。
why_it_matters: 这项变化直接影响云原生集群的资源治理。资深运维开发人员应将其纳入节点基线、容量规划、压测和内存相关可观测性检查。对于 AIOps 场景，内存压力、容器行为与节点资源信号是异常检测和根因分析的重要输入；默认启用也意味着升级评估不能忽略其对既有工作负载的影响。
interview_expression: I would evaluate Memory QoS during a Kubernetes upgrade through workload testing, capacity planning, and node-level observability. Because it is enabled by default in v1.37, I would verify its behavior on memory-sensitive workloads before production rollout.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta
sources.summary:
Memory QoS has graduated to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 and is now enabled by default. On Linux nodes running cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to give the kernel better guidance on how to treat container memory. It was first introduced as Alpha in v1.22, and expanded in v1.36 with tiered memory reservation.

This post covers what changed in v1.37, what the Beta promotion means for cluster operators, and how to configure the feature.
